description: This is a command-line interface (CLI) source file for a project initialization tool called 'universalinit.' It defines functions to parse parameters, create project configurations, handle template information, and manage CLI arguments for initializing various types of projects or retrieving specific commands. The code interacts with classes like ProjectConfig, ProjectType, ProjectInitializer, and TemplateInitInfo from other modules, and provides detailed help and usage examples.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Represents the initial configuration information for project templates, including commands, environment setups, init files, and scripts for pre- and post-processing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a string of comma-separated key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object to fetch template info without full user input.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths suitable for JSON serialization.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints the output JSON for success/failure messages related to project initialization.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the run command for a specific project type as a JSON object.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles argument processing for retrieving the run command of a specified project type.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function parsing CLI arguments, orchestrating project initialization or command retrieval, and handling exceptions.
